crossRefs.note: ‘Yahweh has produced our righteousness: come, and let’s declare in Zion the work of Yahweh our God.’
The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges…
When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
Sing, you heavens, for Yahweh has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains…
Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With a voice of singing announce this, tell it even to the end of the earth…
Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains, for Yahweh has comforted his people, and will…
I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath…
The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
“Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…
“Make the arrows sharp! Hold the shields firmly! Yahweh has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because…
For a nation comes up out of the north against her, which will make her land desolate, and no one will dwell in it.…
For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and…
“Behold, a people comes from the north; and a great nation and many kings will be stirred up from the uttermost parts…

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, will sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers will come to her from the north,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Then heaven and earth and all that is in them will shout for joy over Babylon because the destroyers from the north will come against her,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers shall come unto her from the north, saith Jehovah.
